title: Physical Modeling Synthesis
description: Mathematical algorithms for recreating acoustic instruments through excitation, resonance, and output simulation

content.overview: Physical modeling uses mathematical algorithms to recreate how real instruments produce sound, creating organic, expressive sounds that respond naturally to playing dynamics

three_stages.excitation: Simulating initial energy input (plucking, striking, bowing, blowing)
three_stages.resonance: Calculating how instrument components vibrate and interact
three_stages.output: Combining calculations into final audio signal

physical_audio.description: UK-based specialist in pure numerical modeling
plugins: Tetrad - quad physical modeling with granular synthesis and metal plates
Preparation 2 - colliding strings with rattle and fret interactions
Modus - strings, plates, springs with collision modeling
Dual Spring Reverb/Dynamic Plate Reverb - mechanical reverb models
physical_audio.key_feature: No samples or impulse responses - pure real-time calculations

atoms.description: Virtual bowing creates evolving organic textures

free_open_source_options.chow_kick: Vintage drum machine membrane circuit modeling

digital_waveguide_modeling.description: Simulates 1D wave propagation in strings and tubes

modal_synthesis.description: Models instruments as sets of resonant modes (partials)
modal_synthesis.concept: Each mode represents a natural frequency of vibration

wave_digital_filters.description: Models scattering junctions and lossless interconnections
wave_digital_filters.application: Efficient simulation of complex acoustic systems

finite_difference_time_domain.used_in: Madrona Labs Kaivo for plates and drums

book.title: Physical Audio Signal Processing by Julius O. Smith III
book.prerequisites: Discrete-time signal processing, filter design, programming

advantages: Expressive realism - responds to performance nuances
Infinite variation - no two notes identical
Small file sizes - no large sample libraries
tradeoffs: CPU intensive - real-time calculations demand processing power
Learning curve - physical parameters vs traditional synth controls
Not always 'perfect' - can lack exact character of specific vintage instruments

content.applications: Cinematic scoring, experimental sound design, electronic music where organic movement and expressive control are prioritized
